roadmap_fit: Fresh frequent-strategy conveyor candidate complementary to C257 funding-shock reversal; contract and hostile tests only.
deferred: market-row, outcome, result-packet or sealed-holdout access
parameter tuning, side selection or subgroup rescue
hypothesis: Large 24-hour relative moves across liquid Binance USD-M perpetuals persist for six more hours because information and forced-flow propagation are gradual; a dollar-neutral long-leader/short-laggard book can capture that continuation after four-fill costs, signed funding and exchange constraints.

metadata_sources_only: research_evidence/prereg filenames and frozen preregistration metadata
selection_provenance.queue_basis: The frozen strategy board explicitly names cross-sectional relative-strength continuation as an uninstantiated frequent hypothesis after the prior registered families.
selection_provenance.duplicate_search: Before freeze, metadata-only case-insensitive searches for cross-sectional, relative-strength, residual-momentum and momentum-cross found no preregistration, numbered candidate contract or result packet for this hypothesis.
selection_provenance.not_holdout_rescue: No C258 market row, return, signal, identity, outcome, result packet or sealed-holdout artifact was opened. Rules were not inferred from any C257 result or from the 2026-09-28/2026-11-05 sealed holdout.

economic_distinction.from_c257: C257 reverses discrete funding-surprise tails after settlements. C258 follows completed-price relative strength each hour and never uses funding to form or rank a signal.
economic_distinction.from_rotation_long_h2: H2 is 4h, long-only, ranks 30-day risk-adjusted return, requires EMA50 and exits on rank/EMA. C258 is an inseparable market-neutral 1h pair, ranks robust 24h relative return, has no EMA or signal exit and holds six hours.
economic_distinction.from_rank_breadth_reversal: RBR trades reversal after breadth crowding with RSI/candle/volume confirmation. C258 is continuation, uses no breadth threshold, RSI, candle color or volume signal, and pairs opposite tails.
economic_distinction.from_time_series_momentum: Existing EMA/time-series cells decide each symbol from its own trend. C258 requires a simultaneous point-in-time cross-section and trades only relative leaders against relative laggards.

authority.future_pin_rule: After all four authority-v6 outputs independently pass and protected-merge, and before any market or outcome read, one mechanical amendment may add their exact byte hashes/content digests and the accepted protected head. It may change no hypothesis, signal, side, universe rule, execution, risk, cost, split, gate, multiplicity or PAPER term. Any other change creates a new numbered candidate.
authority.pre_market_gate: Validate the authority-v6 plan byte hash, output byte hashes/content digests, cutoff-exclusive rule, PIT-v9 weekly cells, filter-v4 fold bindings and coverage-v4 ZERO_GUARANTEED_PERIOD_GAPS before opening any 1h bar, mark or funding row. Missing or mismatched authority refuses the run.
authority.membership: At each completed 1h decision close d, use the PIT-v9 crypto book from the greatest weekly Monday cell with monday_ms<=d, preserving artifact order, then apply the checksum-bound filter-v4 snapshot frozen for that fold. Current membership, archive availability, union-of-fold membership, survivor filtering and future cells are forbidden.
authority.availability: Use only completed 1h klines, causal mark closes and funding rows available by the event being processed. Exact timestamps inner-join; never forward-fill, backfill, interpolate, synthesize zero funding or bridge a missing canonical bar.

splits.boundary_rule: Every development/fold window starts flat. No position, statistic, decision, fill or funding attribution crosses a boundary. Prior rows may warm the fixed 24-bar statistic but cannot contribute P&L.
splits.one_shot_rule: Development can only reject C258. A development survivor runs unchanged through all three forward folds once. No threshold, side, symbol, regime, holding period, stop, pair count, cost or capital slice may be tuned or rescued; the sealed holdout remains closed.

signal.decision_clock: At every completed canonical 1h candle close d, after all inputs for d are causally available, form one cross-section. Decisions at d can fill only at the next available canonical 1h open.
signal.effective_set: PIT/filter-eligible symbols with finite contiguous completed closes at d and d-24h and at least 24 completed true ranges ending at d. Require at least 16 effective symbols; otherwise record a zero-trade decision.
signal.return_24h: r24=close_d/close_d_minus_24h-1 using exact canonical timestamps; compressed time or the nearest available earlier candle is forbidden.
signal.robust_score: m=median(r24 over the effective set); mad=median(abs(r24-m)); scale=1.4826*mad; z=(r24-m)/scale. Non-positive or non-finite scale makes the decision zero-trade.

tails.rationale: A fixed robust 1.5-scale cross-sectional tail is an ex-ante material-relative-move definition; it was not selected from C258 outcomes.

signal.ordering: Long candidates sort by z descending then symbol ascending. Short candidates sort by z ascending then symbol ascending.
signal.pairing: Pair rank i long with rank i short for i=1..3. Require both tails. An unavailable, occupied or infeasible member causes indexed pair i to be skipped; never re-pair, backfill or promote an unpaired member. Continue independently to i+1.
signal.weights: Before exchange rounding, target equal raw notional on the long and short legs. After deterministic step-floor sizing, actual rounded raw notionals need not be exactly equal; admission requires only the frozen mismatch ratio abs(long_raw_notional-short_raw_notional)/max(long_raw_notional,short_raw_notional)<=0.01. Exact equality is neither required nor inferred. No beta, volatility, outcome or symbol weighting is fit.
signal.duplicate_rule: A symbol may occur once per decision and cannot open another C258 leg while already held by C258.

execution.entry: Both legs enter atomically at the first available 1h open strictly after decision close d. Same-candle close, same-candle open and partial one-leg admission are forbidden.
execution.fixed_exit: Both legs exit at the first available 1h open whose open_time is at least six hours after actual entry. No signal exit, target, partial, trailing stop, pyramiding or DCA.
execution.atr: ATR24 uses completed causal 1h bars through d with true_range=max(high-low,abs(high-previous_close),abs(low-previous_close)) and Wilder RMA alpha=1/24, seeded by the first 24 valid true ranges inside the contiguous segment.
execution.protective_stop: Each leg receives a reduce-only stop two frozen ATR24 values from its raw entry reference price. Gap/open is checked before range touch. A long gap stop uses min(stop,bar_open), a short gap stop uses max(stop,bar_open); a non-gap range touch uses stop. Stops never embed slippage. If one leg stops, its mate remains protected and is flattened at the next available 1h open; if both stop in one bar, both fills are booked independently.
execution.ambiguity: When a stop and fixed exit can occur in the same unresolved bar, the stop wins. Missing next-open or exposure-lifecycle authority makes the whole candidate INCOMPLETE, never a favorable inferred fill or dropped episode.
execution.atomic_failure: If exactly one entry leg is accepted or the second leg is uncertain, create exactly one ATOMIC_ONE_LEG_LOSS closed-attempt row under the original pair attempt_id. Keep the accepted leg protected by its frozen 2ATR stop and flatten it at the following available 1h open, never at the same open; a stop touched first wins. Freeze field signs: movement_cash is signed (favorable positive, adverse negative); funding_cash is signed (credit positive, debit negative); fee_drag=sum(abs(quantity*execution_price)*fee_bps/10000) is finite and nonnegative; slippage_drag=sum(abs(quantity)*abs(execution_price-reference_price)) is finite and nonnegative; execution_failure_penalty_drag=0.0 is frozen, finite and nonnegative. actual_net_cash=movement_cash+funding_cash-fee_drag-slippage_drag. verdict_net_cash=min(actual_net_cash,-(fee_drag+slippage_drag+execution_failure_penalty_drag)), guaranteeing the atomic defect cannot be positive or be rescued by signed-cost conventions, favorable movement or funding. At the final stop/cleanup fill timestamp append conservative_adjustment_cash=verdict_net_cash-actual_net_cash (always <=0) after actual cashflows; verdict cashflow drawdown uses actual event cashflows plus this adjustment and sums exactly to verdict_net_cash. atomic_initial_risk_cash is the accepted leg's nonnegative raw reference-price loss from entry to its frozen stop plus stressed nonnegative fee_drag and slippage_drag on that actual entry and one complete stop/cleanup exit, all exactly once; it must be finite and positive. atomic_trade_R=verdict_net_cash/atomic_initial_risk_cash. This row is included without exception in closed-pair sample count, net/mean R, PF, cashflow and marked drawdown, week/month/fold/side/symbol/regime attribution, bootstrap, concentration, stress replay and every development, forward and PAPER transfer gate. Zero accepted legs is a pre-entry indexed skip, not an economic row. Missing protection, cleanup, mark, funding or fill authority makes the entire candidate INCOMPLETE and cannot exclude the row.
execution.exchange_rules: Apply frozen point-in-time PRICE_FILTER, MARKET_LOT_SIZE, MIN_NOTIONAL and maximum quantity to every entry and exit. Floor quantity; never round up or substitute current exchangeInfo.

sizing.capital_selection_rule: Only the complete 2000 USD replay can admit/skip primary attempts and pass or reject economic, sample, frequency, regime, drawdown, inference and PAPER-admission gates. The 1000/3000/4000 USD replays are replay-local feasibility diagnostics: their sizing, rounding, infeasibility, skip, fill, P&L or verdict cannot veto, select, rescue, replace, average with, alter an admission in, or otherwise affect the 2000 USD primary replay. Conversely, primary feasibility does not manufacture a diagnostic fill.
sizing.book_equity: Each replay starts with settled_cash_equity equal to its declared capital and no positions. At an entry open t: process funding_time<t; mark every existing leg with the latest verified 1h mark close whose close_time<t; execute due exits/cleanup; then book_equity=settled_cash_equity+sum(side_sign*qty*(causal_mark-raw_entry_reference_price)) over remaining legs. Same-open proposed legs contribute nothing before admission. Missing or non-positive equity/mark is INCOMPLETE.
sizing.r_cash: R_cash_at_attempt=0.01*book_equity frozen immediately before that indexed pair attempt. requested_pair_risk_cash=1.0*R_cash_at_attempt. Each admitted normal pair stores immutable initial_pair_risk_cash equal to its actual rounded aggregate modeled simultaneous-stop loss; trade_R=pair verdict_net_cash/initial_pair_risk_cash. The value must be finite and positive.
sizing.continuous_start: For each leg j, loss_per_unit_j=abs(raw_entry_reference_price_j-stop_reference_price_j)+stressed_entry_fee_drag_per_unit_j+stressed_entry_slippage_drag_per_unit_j+stressed_stop_fee_drag_per_unit_j+stressed_stop_slippage_drag_per_unit_j, where every *_drag_per_unit is finite and nonnegative. loss_rate_per_raw_notional_j=loss_per_unit_j/raw_entry_reference_price_j. equal_raw_notional_start=min(0.25*book_equity,requested_pair_risk_cash/(loss_rate_per_raw_notional_long+loss_rate_per_raw_notional_short)). continuous_qty_j=equal_raw_notional_start/raw_entry_reference_price_j. Every denominator must be finite and positive.
sizing.step_floor_and_search: For each leg independently set q0_j=floor(continuous_qty_j/stepSize_j)*stepSize_j using exact Decimal arithmetic. Validate minQty, maxQty and minNotional without rounding up. Starting only from (q0_long,q0_short), repeatedly compute raw notionals. If neutrality fails, decrement exactly one MARKET_LOT_SIZE step from the larger-notional leg; if notionals are exactly equal choose no decrement because neutrality already passes. Never increase a leg, change the pair, search upward or branch. After every decrement revalidate quantity/notional/filter bounds. Stop at the first passing pair; if a decrement would violate a bound, after 100000 decrements, or no passing state remains, record PAIR_SIZE_INFEASIBLE and skip before entry.
sizing.neutrality: A rounded pair passes only when abs(long_raw_notional-short_raw_notional)/max(long_raw_notional,short_raw_notional)<=0.01. Raw notional=quantity*raw entry reference price before adverse slippage. Actual rounded notionals may differ by any amount within this inclusive tolerance; exact equality is not required. The first passing state from the frozen decrement order is final; no alternative tie-break, closest-match optimization or caller override exists.
sizing.post_rounding_checks: At the first neutrality-passing state recompute aggregate stressed simultaneous-stop loss from both raw stop moves and all four nonnegative stressed fee_drag/slippage_drag fills exactly once. Require 0<initial_pair_risk_cash<=requested_pair_risk_cash, pair gross<=0.5*book_equity, and existing_remaining_stressed_stop_loss+initial_pair_risk_cash<=0.03*book_equity. If a post-rounding check fails, decrement the larger-raw-notional leg one step; on exact raw-notional equality decrement the leg whose symbol sorts lexicographically later, then return to the neutrality check. Apply the same bound/infeasible rules and never increase. Existing remaining loss is recomputed from current quantities to frozen stops plus stressed required-exit costs.
sizing.primary_gate: All headline R, frequency, PF, drawdown, bootstrap and promotion values come only from the 2000 USD primary replay using this exact sizing algorithm.

risk.pair_risk: The sizing section defines requested and actual pair risk mechanically. Slippage is charged exactly once and is not embedded in reference-price movement.
risk.feasibility: Exchange rounding, neutrality, risk and impact feasibility are computed independently inside each capital replay. Only the 2000 USD replay's result admits or skips the primary indexed pair. A 1000/3000/4000 USD diagnostic failure produces a skip only in that diagnostic and is reported; it cannot veto, select, rescue or alter the 2000 USD primary trade set or verdict.
risk.correlation_disclosure: Report long/short gross imbalance, pair and book return correlations, BTC beta, same-hour cluster size and strategy-level overlap with C257. Dollar neutrality is not claimed to remove common crypto beta or crash correlation.

regime.stream: BTCUSDT 1h klines from the exact authority-v6 manifest, independent of whether BTCUSDT is in the current C258 PIT trading membership. Current/websocket/REST BTC data and another symbol are forbidden.
regime.fold_reset_and_warmup: Reset at each development or forward-fold start. Use only contiguous canonical BTCUSDT 1h closes inside that same window. The first 199 completed closes are warm-up and no C258 entry may be admitted. Seed EMA200 at the 200th completed close as math.fsum(the first 200 binary64 closes)/200. A missing/non-finite close breaks contiguity, discards the seed and requires 200 new contiguous closes before another admission.
regime.ema_formula: After the seed candle, EMA200_d=(2/201)*close_d+(199/201)*EMA200_previous, evaluated in IEEE-754 binary64 in that written operation order. The decision candle close is included once; no future or same-open value enters.
regime.as_of: At C258 decision close d, require the BTCUSDT candle with exact close timestamp d and the EMA200 value computed through d only. close_d>=EMA200_d is BTC_ABOVE_OR_ON_EMA200; close_d<EMA200_d is BTC_BELOW_EMA200. Equality belongs only to ABOVE_OR_ON. A pair decision lacking this exact causal label is zero-trade; an admitted row lacking or changing the label makes the candidate INCOMPLETE.
regime.boundary: No EMA seed or state crosses development/fold boundaries. Regime attribution is frozen at the pair's entry decision and every normal or atomic-failure row keeps that label through close.

costs.pnl_rule: Freeze field signs for every normal and atomic fill: movement_cash is signed (favorable positive, adverse negative); funding_cash is signed (credit positive, debit negative); fee_drag=abs(quantity*execution_price)*fee_bps/10000 is finite and nonnegative; slippage_drag=abs(quantity)*abs(execution_price-reference_price) is finite and nonnegative. For buys execution_price=reference_price*(1+slippage_bps/10000); for sells execution_price=reference_price*(1-slippage_bps/10000). actual_net_cash=movement_cash+funding_cash-sum(fee_drag)-sum(slippage_drag). Movement uses raw reference prices only; never encode a cost as signed negative drag, add a drag, compute movement from execution price, or subtract slippage twice.
costs.funding: At every settlement during exposure, book signed funding_cash=-side_sign*abs(quantity)*causal_mark_price*funding_rate, with side_sign=+1 long and -1 short, funding credits positive and debits negative. Use the last verified 1h mark close strictly before nominal_time. An entry at the same timestamp precedes funding and includes it; an open exit precedes same-timestamp funding and excludes it; no debit or credit may be omitted.
costs.impact: For every proposed fill use the latest completed 1h quote-volume bar strictly before the fill. impact_ratio=abs(quantity*reference_price)/prior_quote_volume. Entry is infeasible above 0.10% or when authority is missing/non-positive. Required protective exits always execute; above-cap exits scale adverse slippage by max(1,impact_ratio/0.001) and make the fold INCOMPLETE_IMPACT_LIMIT.
costs.stress: Re-run the causal book with 5bp taker and 10bp adverse slippage per fill. Multiply negative funding debits by 1.5 and divide positive funding credits by 1.5; stress never improves a fill, changes selection or flips a funding sign.

median at least 30 closed pairs per UTC week including zero weeks
at least 2 of 3 forward folds have positive net R
long-leg and short-leg standalone net contributions are each non-negative

strictly more than 55% of UTC calendar months intersecting the three folds have positive primary-replay net R; every intersecting zero-trade month remains in the denominator and atomic-failure rows remain included

drawdown_tiers.elevated: 15R<max drawdown<=30R and total net R/max drawdown>=1.5
drawdown_tiers.high: 30R<max drawdown<=60R, total net R/max drawdown>=2.0, stress net R/stress max drawdown>=1.0, and future PAPER pair-risk multiplier<=min(0.5,15/max_drawdown_R)

required_report: net R, mean R, PF, win rate, max drawdown, recovery duration and return/drawdown ratio
gross R, nonnegative fee_drag, nonnegative slippage_drag, signed funding_cash and impact failures
fold, week, month, side, symbol, regime and capital-simulation breakdowns
frequency, exposure, occupancy, correlation, BTC beta and C257 strategy overlap
base and stressed full-book results, bootstrap interval/p-value, authority gaps and full trial ledger

statistics.ordered_unit: closed paired attempt ordered by entry timestamp then long symbol then short symbol
statistics.statistic: mean after-cost net R per closed paired attempt
statistics.method: Politis-Romano stationary bootstrap with a frozen fixed-draw implementation
statistics.prng: numpy 2.5.3 numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(seed)); Generator.random(size=(resamples,n,2),dtype=float64) in C order. PCG64, not PCG64DXSM or default_rng substitution, is mandatory.
statistics.fixed_draw_stationary_resample: For each replicate b and ordered observation position j consume exactly two pre-drawn float64 uniforms u_restart=data[b,j,0] and u_index=data[b,j,1]. At j=0 set index=floor(u_index*n) and ignore u_restart. At j>0, if u_restart<1/21 set index=floor(u_index*n), else set index=(previous_index+1)%n while still consuming u_index. Copy ordered verdict_R[index]. Thus each distribution consumes exactly resamples*n*2 uniforms and has output length n; n=0 fails closed.
statistics.p_value: Observed T=math.fsum(verdict_R)/n. Center each verdict_R by subtracting T, run exactly 10000 fixed-draw replicates with null_seed, compute each replicate mean with math.fsum/n, and report (1+count(T_star>=T))/(10000+1), inclusive upper tail.
statistics.confidence_interval: Run exactly 10000 uncentered fixed-draw replicates with ci_seed. Compute each mean with math.fsum/n; report numpy.quantile(method='linear') at 0.025 and 0.975. Atomic-failure verdict_R observations are ordinary ordered observations in both distributions.

multiplicity.promotable_primary: the combined inseparable long-leader/short-laggard paired book only
multiplicity.ledger_rule: Append every scheduled decision, zero-trade cross-section, indexed pair skip, attempt, atomic failure, base/stress row and rejection. Prior candidates and rejected families remain counted; diagnostics cannot be selected as alternatives.
multiplicity.no_rescue: A side, symbol, regime, month, fold, capital slice, baseline or diagnostic cannot rescue the single primary. Any rule change is a new numbered candidate.

prerequisites: all forward gates pass on one exact clean protected head
independent exact-head reproduction passes with byte-bound authorities
runtime causal-parity, exchange-filter, stop-protection and rollback drills pass
isolated C258 book and immutable cohort evidence are ready
paper_admission.bounded_canary: Start at 0.25R aggregate pair risk, maximum three pairs and 0.75R total C258 open risk. High-drawdown tier applies the stricter frozen multiplier. No mainnet authority.
paper_admission.paper_transfer_gate: At least 100 complete measured paired closes over at least 14 Cairo days, positive actual-cost mean net R and PF>1.05, no unprotected lot, no cost-incomplete ranked close, no risk/protection breach, and measured direction consistent with historical OOS. PAPER cannot rescue a historical failure.
paper_admission.rollback: Any unknown account state, protection failure, authority drift, incomplete costs or causal mismatch disables new C258 entries immediately while existing testnet exposure remains protected and managed.

falsification: Reject at development on any development gate failure; do not open forward folds.
Reject after the one-shot forward run on any final gate failure; do not tune, subset, rescue or inspect the sealed holdout.
Reject if profitability disappears after realistic fees, adverse slippage, signed funding, exchange rounding or stress.
Reject if either leg supplies all economics or if common-market correlation defeats the disclosed pair-risk ceiling.
Reject any run that uses future membership, current filters, compressed time, fill-bar volume, missing authority substitution or a favorable inferred fill.
A rejection is final for C258 and immediately advances the next preregistered family.
